title: 013 保证完成任务014 誓师大会
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
“补习班？”
刘静正在收拾着吃完的碗筷，她疑惑问道：“你们不是现在就在学校补课了吗？怎么还需要补习啊？小泽你是不是觉得自己有点跟不上班里的课程？”
正在喝水的季杨杨顿时呛了一口。
“妈，我表哥这个学习的速度连乔英子那种学霸都感叹，他刚来没几天就追上了尖子生的水平。”
刘静更加疑惑：“那为什么要补习啊？”
陆泽耐心解释：“主要是我理科上面的知识太过于杂乱，需要老师帮助我系统的从头开始整理一下，这样的工作显然不能让学校的老师帮忙，所以我就想...”
“而且我们在正式开学以后会有个分班考试。”
“到时候会按照考试成绩分成冲刺班、基础班跟平行班，我主要是为表弟考虑。”
“他的基础更差，要想在这最后一年冲刺上去，必须得下猛药。”
季杨杨一脸懵逼，怎么都没想到这件事最终会搞到自己的头上。
他刚想说点什么，却发现妈妈已经点了点头：“那好，小姨同意啦。”
刘静一向是非常尊重两个孩子自己的想法。
听到这是为了他们的学习，直接便答应了下来。
陆泽看着面前表情温和的小姨，他这时候忽然想到了一件关键的事情，连忙问道：“对了，小姨，你上周六不是去体检了吗？体检的结果现在出来了没有？”
按照小欢喜原著里的剧情，刘静是在元旦之前的时候确认了乳腺癌。
距离现在也仅仅四個月的时间。
虽然她最终经历过治疗病情有所好转，可是陆泽不想看到小姨在病床上面被病魔折磨的样子，所以他在转学过来的第一天就在电梯里提醒了刘静要记得进行体检，就是想能够早点让小姨进行治疗。
不管什么病，在早期一定是要比晚期更好治。
“没有呢，估计过两天可以出来。”
叮咚！

听见门铃响起，刘静快速起身：“估计是老季这个家伙又忘记带钥匙啦，他啊，老是这个样子。”
打开房门，果不其然，西装革履的老季脸上带着尴尬的笑：“哎呦，今天出门出的急，忘记带钥匙啦。”
季胜利换上鞋子后，挺着圆滚滚的肚子来到餐桌旁。
“呦，你们都吃完啦？”
陆泽笑着跟小姨父打了声招呼，季杨杨不情不愿的喊了声爸，虽然跟家里的关系有所缓和，但他也是对妈妈刘静更加亲近，对于这个当区长的父亲依然有着隔阂。
刘静过来：“刚刚两个孩子说想要找个补习班，老季，你有认识的人没有？”
陆泽连忙说道：“那个什么，小姨小姨夫，我跟杨杨都看好啦，我们班第一名乔英子，她妈妈就是教育机构的老师，在家里面开了个补习班，那里就挺不错的。”
“哦？这样啊。”
“那找时间，我跟你小姨父去拜访一下人家。”
......
回到房间，季杨杨看着表哥，不情不愿道：“表哥，伱想去英子家里补习我不拦着，可你怎么也把我给拽上去了啊，我对学习真的不感兴趣，我的梦想是...”
content_en:
"Cram school?"
Liu Jing was clearing away the dishes after finishing her meal. She asked doubtfully: "Aren't you guys making up lessons at school now? Why do you still need tutoring? Ozawa, do you feel like you can't keep up with the classes at work?"
Ji Yangyang, who was drinking water, suddenly choked.
"Mom, my cousin's learning speed makes even top students like Qiao Yingzi sigh. He has caught up with the top students within a few days of arriving."
Liu Jing was even more confused: "Then why do you need tutoring?"
Lu Ze explained patiently: "The main reason is that my science knowledge is too complicated, and I need the teacher to help me sort it out systematically from scratch. Obviously I can't let the school teachers help me with this kind of work, so I thought..."
"And we will have a placement test after the official start of school."
"The students will be divided into sprint classes, basic classes and parallel classes based on test scores. I mainly think about my cousin."
"His foundation is even worse. If he wants to sprint forward in this final year, he must take strong medicine."
Ji Yangyang looked confused, never expecting that this matter would eventually happen to him.
He was about to say something, but found that his mother had already nodded: "Okay, aunt agrees."
Liu Jing has always respected the two children's own ideas.
When he heard that this was for their study, he immediately agreed.
Lu Ze looked at the gentle aunt in front of him. He suddenly thought of a key thing and asked quickly: "By the way, aunt, didn't you go for a physical examination last Saturday? Are the results of the physical examination out now?"
According to the plot in Xiao Huanxi's original novel, Liu Jing was diagnosed with breast cancer before New Year's Day.
It's only four months from now.
Although her condition improved after treatment, Lu Ze didn't want to see his aunt tortured by the disease on the hospital bed, so he reminded Liu Jing in the elevator on the first day he transferred to another school to remember to have a physical examination, just so that his aunt could receive treatment as soon as possible.
No matter what kind of disease it is, it is better to treat it in the early stage than in the late stage.
"No, I think I can come out in two days."
Ding dong!
Hearing the doorbell ringing, Liu Jing stood up quickly: "I guess it's Lao Ji who forgot to bring his key again. He's always like this."
Opening the door, as expected, Lao Ji in a suit and tie had an awkward smile on his face: "Oh, I was in a hurry today and forgot to bring my key."
After Ji Shengli put on his shoes, he came to the dining table with a round belly.
"Hey, have you all finished eating?"
Lu Ze smiled and said hello to his uncle, and Ji Yangyang reluctantly called dad. Although the relationship with his family has eased, he has become closer to his mother Liu Jing, and there is still a gap between him and his father, who is the district chief.
Liu Jing came over: "The two children just said they wanted to find a cram school. Lao Ji, do you know anyone?"
Lu Ze quickly said: "What, aunt and uncle, Yang Yang and I are optimistic about Qiao Yingzi, who is number one in our class. Her mother is a teacher at an educational institution. She runs a cram school at home, and it's pretty good there."
"Oh? That's it."
"Then find some time, your uncle and I will go visit them."
...
Back in the room, Ji Yangyang looked at his cousin and said reluctantly: "Cousin, I won't stop you from going to Yingzi's house for tutoring, but you dragged me up anyway. I'm really not interested in studying. My dream is..."
